audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were marked Skill and the two-item stage was marked Shen, against the packet chart of Skill / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Skill.
audit.why: Shen wins 54.45% over 1,023 games and the prose already claims those middle stages ('the match tilts in your favor', 'you are running the pattern freely'). The two-item row is the one that genuinely levels off, because Unstable Matter is percent-health damage every 5 seconds and Cell Division heals him — the exact stage where Shen's HP stacking stops being an answer.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Skill in BOTH layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere. 'Track Elastic Slingshot' appeared a dozen times without ever saying how long it is down for.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9 — at rank 1 that is a 21-second hole, the longest punishable cooldown either champion has in lane and longer than Shen's own 18s Shadow Dash. Unstable Matter is 5s, Stretching Strikes 14s, Let's Bounce! 120s, Stand United 200s.
audit.corrected: 21s written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and whys[2], turning 'respect his engage' into 'taunt after it lands, then you have 21 seconds'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabrications. (1) Zac's ultimate was called 'Let's Make This Quick' in whys[6], spikes[3].text, wants.foe[1] and twice in late — it is Let's Bounce!. (2) wants.you[1] told the player Ki Barrier absorbs his 'Counter Strike counterplay' — Counter Strike is a Jax ability and Zac does not have it.
audit.why: Both were confidently wrong names on a paying page. Separately, wants.you[0] was incoherent about what Spirit's Refuge does: it blocks ATTACKS, so Unstable Matter (W, 5s, percent max health) passes straight through the zone — the mirror audit on zac__shen states this from his side and the two pages must agree.
audit.corrected: All five ultimate references renamed to Let's Bounce!; the Jax ability removed; wants.you[0] rewritten to say Spirit's Refuge eats his autos after the Slingshot but not Unstable Matter. Also carried the mirror's point that Stretching Strikes is an 800-range grab, not a movement tool, so it is Elastic Slingshot alone that closes distance.

audit.why: packet flagged 'Land Elastic Slingshot' in wants.foe[0] — FALSE POSITIVE, that is Zac's real E. Left untouched.

edits.before: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — His engage. E-taunt after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Elastic Slingshot: 21s at rank 1 — his engage, so taunt after it lands. - Unstable Matter: 5s, percent max health, and W does not block it. - Shadow Dash: 18s, never on chip. - Stand United: 200s, kill windows only.

edits.before: His engage. E-taunt after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His engage, 21s at rank 1. Taunt after it lands, never before it.

edits.before: Full kit online — Elastic Slingshot is the only threat; watch his charge animation and pre-place Spirit's Refuge on your own position so he lands into the zone already active.
edits.after: Full kit online — Elastic Slingshot (21s at rank 1) is the one threat; watch the charge-up and pre-place Spirit's Refuge on yourself so he lands into a live zone.

edits.before: Zac's Let's Make This Quick is a legitimate teamfight threat; use Stand United reactively to arrive inside the bounce and E-taunt him the moment he lands, turning his engage into yours.
edits.after: Zac's Let's Bounce! is a legitimate teamfight threat; use Stand United reactively to arrive inside the bounce and E-taunt him the moment he lands, turning his engage into yours.

edits.before: Let's Make This Quick gives Zac a massive teamfight bounce-engage; respect it and use Stand United reactively to deny him a clean multi-man knockup.
edits.after: Let's Bounce! gives Zac a four-bounce teamfight engage; respect it and use Stand United reactively to deny him a clean multi-man knockup.

edits.before: In the late game Zac's Let's Make This Quick becomes his main win condition — a five-man bounce engage is one of the best teamfight openers in the game, and he can build pure tank while doing it. Your job is to use Stand United reactively: when he launches the engage, your global teleport arrives in the chaos and your E-taunt immediately locks him down inside the bounce, turning his own engage into a death sentence. Peel your carries with Spirit's Refuge during his bounce-landing autos, and accept that the late-game split is more about your R timing than raw stats. You still win the 1v1 because his blobs do not fix the taunt problem, but the game is decided by which team gets caught by Let's Make This Quick first.
edits.after: In the late game Zac's Let's Bounce! becomes his main win condition — a four-bounce knock-up engage is one of the best teamfight openers in the game, and he can build pure tank while doing it. Your job is to use Stand United reactively: when he launches the engage, your global teleport arrives in the chaos and your E-taunt immediately locks him down inside the bounce, turning his own engage into a death sentence. Peel your carries with Spirit's Refuge during his bounce-landing autos, and accept that the late-game split is more about your R timing than raw stats. You still win the 1v1 because his blobs do not fix the taunt problem, but the game is decided by which team gets caught by Let's Bounce! first.

edits.after: Keep Spirit's Refuge up for the autos that follow his Slingshot — it eats attacks, so Unstable Matter still burns through it every 5s

edits.after: E-taunt him into the spirit blade path so Twilight Assault's max-health damage lands and Ki Barrier eats the return hit

edits.before: Farm his blobs passively to sustain through your trades and stall until Let's Make This Quick can swing a teamfight
edits.after: Reabsorb his Cell Division blobs to sustain through your trades and stall until Let's Bounce! can swing a teamfight

notes: The kit file tags Zac's E with a 'grounding' flag; Riot's description is only 'attaches his arms to the ground and launches himself forward', with nothing about denying dashes, so I treated the flag as a parsing misfire and wrote NOTHING about Elastic Slingshot grounding Shadow Dash. Cell Division's revive (splits into 4 bloblets on fatal damage) is real per Riot's text but the existing content only ever talks about blob healing — I did not add the revive because it would need a new sentence, not a same-length swap; it is worth a follow-up edit. Whether Spirit's Refuge blocks the bounce-landing hits of Let's Bounce! is not in Riot's text; the existing 'peel with W during his bounce-landing autos' line was left as written.
